title: KP2PLab Experiment Analysis
description: Analyze Peer counts, message events, valid envelope propagation latency, network configuration, and Agent status for KP2PLab v3 experiments.

options.content: **Select a Run, Agent, and Topic, then adjust the time range.** `Total` shows the current collector counter value; `Selected range` shows the estimated increase calculated with `increase`. Per-second rates use `rate` over an interval matched to the scrape frequency. **Propagation latency includes valid received envelopes only and is unavailable for raw messages.** Missing observations are not filled with zero.

panels.title: Online Agents
panels.description: Current online hosts matching the Agent filter. The Run and Topic filters do not affect this panel.

panels.title: Ready Peers
panels.description: Current ready Peers for the selected runs and Agents. Ready does not guarantee a stable mesh. Zero is shown only when Peers in another state have been observed for the selected runs and Agents. If the selection has no observations, it remains No observations.

panels.title: Published · Total
panels.description: Sum of publish counters currently retained by the collector. This is not the increase over the selected time range, and it may reset when the collector restarts.

panels.title: Published · Selected range
panels.description: Estimated increase in published messages over the selected time range. Prometheus increase accounts for interval boundaries and counter resets, so the result may not be an integer.

panels.title: Failures · Selected range
panels.description: Estimated increase in publish/leave failures handled with onError: continue over the selected time range. Failures that stop a run with onError: fail and join failures are not included. Also check for failed runs in the Run status and phase panel.

panels.title: Telemetry loss · Range
panels.description: Events reported as lost in the telemetry pipeline during the selected time range. This is separate from P2P packet loss and affects the completeness of the analysis.

panels.title: Peer states
panels.description: Peer counts by state at scrape time. Stopped and failed Peers are included while retained in experiment records. Zero is shown only when Peers in another state have been observed for the selected runs and Agents. If the selection has no observations, it remains No observations.

panels.title: Message events / sec
panels.description: Per-second rates of collected events. Delivery occurs at multiple Peers, so the delivery rate can exceed the publish rate. Do not interpret their ratio as message reachability.

panels.title: Published / delivered bytes per second
panels.description: Instrumented PubSub data bytes. Raw data equals payloadSize; envelopes include JSON metadata and base64 encoding. This does not include TCP/IP framing, retransmissions, or libp2p signatures.

panels.title: Propagation latency · P50 / P95 / P99
panels.description: Valid propagation latency from received envelopes only. Raw messages, negative samples caused by clock skew, and intervals without observations are excluded. Quantiles are estimated from histogram buckets. Synchronize clocks across hosts.

panels.title: Mesh changes per second
panels.description: GRAFT/PRUNE follow the selected Topic filter. remove_peer is a Peer-level event without a topic and is shown independently of that filter. This chart shows event rates, not current mesh degree.

panels.title: Operation failures per second
panels.description: Rate of publish/leave failures handled with onError: continue. Failures that stop an experiment are not included in this counter. Also check for failed runs in the Run status and phase panel.

panels.title: Telemetry events dropped per second
panels.description: Events reported as lost in the telemetry pipeline. Message and mesh-event rates may be incomplete during these intervals. This is not the P2P network packet-loss rate.

panels.title: PubSub bytes · Selected range
panels.description: Estimated increase in PubSub data bytes over the selected time range, grouped by direction and encoding. Interface framing and retransmissions are not included.

panels.title: Configured base delay · Mean / min / max
panels.description: Mean, minimum, and maximum base delay configured for ready/starting Peers. These are not measured packet RTT or propagation latency. Scope identifies the traffic affected by the impairment.

panels.title: Configured packet loss · Mean
panels.description: Mean configured loss probability for ready/starting Peers. This is not measured packet loss or the proportion of undelivered messages.

panels.title: Configured jitter · Mean
panels.description: Mean configured jitter for ready/starting Peers. Actual packet delay varies with the configured distribution; this value is not measured jitter.

panels.title: Peers with network configuration
panels.description: Ready/starting Peers included in network configuration metrics. Stopped and failed Peers are excluded.

panels.title: Agent capacity used
panels.description: Active Peer count divided by Agent capacity. This is not CPU or memory utilization. Agents with zero or unobserved capacity have no value.

panels.title: Time since last Agent report
panels.description: Elapsed time since the Agent last reported its status, not since the last Prometheus scrape. The Run and Topic filters do not affect this panel.

panels.title: Run status and phase
panels.description: Current state and phase number of selected runs. The Run filter applies; Agent and Topic filters do not.

panels.title: Experiment job states
panels.description: Current job counts by state for the selected runs, including terminal states such as completed, failed, and canceled.

list.name: agent
list.label: Agent
list.description: Select Agents to analyze. This also filters status and resource panels.

list.name: topic
list.label: Topic
list.description: Applies to messages, propagation latency, and GRAFT/PRUNE. Peer removal events have no topic.
